spec_family.name: Exterior Deck Repaint/Restain
spec_family.description: Condition-dependent restaining/repainting of existing exterior wood deck surfaces — floor field (SF), railing system (LF), spindles/balusters (EA), and stair steps (EA). Assessment-first workflow: existing coating type identification, adhesion testing, condition rating, and compatibility check before committing to prep strategy. Coating_type remains the primary configuration dimension (semi_transparent, semi_solid, solid_stain — clear_sealer excluded from RP scope). Existing_coating_condition (sound/worn/failing/peeling) replaces NC wood_condition as the secondary dimension driving prep intensity. Chemical restoration (strip, brighten, rinse) activated for failing/peeling conditions — requires separate mobilization day. Coating compatibility matrix enforced: penetrating over penetrating = safe, film over penetrating = safe, penetrating over film = FAIL (strip mandatory). Solid stain delamination risk is COMPOUNDED on RP (each coat adds film thickness on horizontal walking surface). Same 4 paintable items as NC (ITM_DECK_FLOOR SF, ITM_DECK_RAILING LF, ITM_DECK_SPINDLE EA, ITM_DECK_STAIR EA). Same 5 protection zones. Application rates identical to NC — prep is the RP cost driver. 43 tasks across 9 modules.

includes: Existing coating condition assessment (sound/worn/failing/peeling per component)
Existing coating type identification (solvent wipe test — penetrating stain, solid stain, paint, unknown)
ASTM D3359 adhesion testing for film-forming existing coatings (solid stain, paint)
Moisture content verification (MC <=15% hard stop, pin-type moisture meter)
Rot probe at vulnerable locations (stair treads, post bases, railing joints, board ends)
Light scuff sand for sound/worn existing coatings (80-100 grit degloss)
Heavy sand for failing/peeling after chemical strip (60-grit residual removal)
Chemical restoration for failing/peeling existing coatings (strip, brighten, rinse — separate mobilization day)
Railing and spindle hand sanding and cleaning
Pressure wash all conditions (1,000-1,500 PSI, fan tip, 24-48 hr dry time)
Mildew eradication treatment (conditional on visible mildew)
Bonding primer for incompatible existing coating (paint over stain, unknown coating type)
Stain application — floor field (spray_backbrush, brush, pad, or roll)
Stain application — railing system (spray_backbrush or brush)
Stain application — spindles/balusters (spray or brush)
Stain application — stair steps (brush only, alternating step pattern)
Second coat application (all RP coating types — stripped/weathered wood absorbs more)
End-grain sealing on stair treads and board ends
Siding protection at deck-to-house ledger board junction
Below-deck landscape protection (elevated decks)
Adjacent hardscape protection (walkways, patios)
Deck furniture staging and return
Deck-mounted light fixture masking
Final walkthrough inspection and touch-up
Tool and equipment cleanup

configuration_dimensions.description: PRIMARY CONFIGURATION DIMENSION — inherited from NC deck spec. Drives coating chemistry, maintenance cycle, failure mode, primer requirement, and material coverage.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Clear_sealer EXCLUDED from RP — maintenance-only reapplication. Semi-transparent remains professional standard (~60%).

configuration_dimensions.description: RP-SPECIFIC DIMENSION — drives prep intensity and chemical restoration activation. Replaces NC wood_condition.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Sound = intact, light prep. Worn = traffic wear, moderate prep. Failing = adhesion loss, chemical strip. Peeling = sheet delamination, full strip + separate mobilization.

configuration_dimensions.description: RP-SPECIFIC. Type of existing coating — drives compatibility assessment and bonding primer activation.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Determines coating compatibility. Penetrating over penetrating = safe. Film over penetrating = safe. Penetrating over film = FAIL (strip mandatory). Unknown = treat as incompatible.

configuration_dimensions.description: Deck wood species. Inherited from NC unchanged.
configuration_dimensions.notes: PT pine ~80% of residential decks. Composite excluded.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique. Spray-only PROHIBITED for penetrating stains.
Which deck components are in scope. RP defaults to floor_only (floor wears first).
configuration_dimensions.notes: RP commonly targets floor_only — railings and stairs may not need recoating when floor does.

paintable_items.counting_rules: Net deck floor field area in square feet. Measured from PaintScope plan view. Excludes railing footprint.
paintable_items.notes: SF-based. Highest wear surface — foot traffic drives RP need. Always active.

paintable_items.counting_rules: Linear feet of deck railing run. Includes top rail, bottom rail, and posts per linear foot.
paintable_items.notes: LF-based. Activated when scope_components = floor_and_railings or full_deck.

paintable_items.name: Deck spindle/baluster (individual vertical member)
paintable_items.counting_rules: Count of individual spindles/balusters. ~3 per LF of railing.
paintable_items.notes: EA-based. Activated when scope_components = floor_and_railings or full_deck.

paintable_items.name: Deck stair step (tread + riser per step)
paintable_items.counting_rules: Count of deck stair steps. Each tread + riser = 1 unit.
paintable_items.notes: EA-based. Activated when scope_components = full_deck. Brush only.

valid_input_states.notes: SS_EXT_STAINED_SEMI = previously coated with penetrating stain. SS_EXT_STAINED_SOLID = previously coated with film-forming solid stain. material_systems.name: Semi-Transparent Penetrating Stain
material_systems.notes: Professional standard. 2 coats on RP (stripped wood absorbs more). No primer.

material_systems.name: Semi-Solid Stain
material_systems.notes: Heavy-pigment penetrating stain. Good for covering RP wear patterns.

material_systems.name: Solid Color Deck Stain
material_systems.notes: Film-forming. DELAMINATION RISK compounded on RP. Tannin-blocking primer conditional on cedar/redwood.

material_systems.name: Bonding Primer for Incompatible Existing Coatings
material_systems.notes: RP-SPECIFIC. Bridges incompatible existing coating. Conditional.

material_systems.name: Deck Cleaner / Stripper (Alkaline)
material_systems.notes: Chemical restoration step 1. Neutralize with brightener.

material_systems.name: Wood Brightener (Oxalic / Citric Acid)
material_systems.notes: Chemical restoration step 2. Neutralizes alkaline residue.

Prep and application. Inherited from NC unchanged.

production_summary.stacking_notes: Worst case: solid_stain (1.25) x peeling (2.00) x redwood (1.15) = 2.88x. Under 4.0x cap. In practice, existing_condition affects prep only, coating_type affects application only.

compatibility_rules.title: Moisture content hard stop
compatibility_rules.rule: MC must read <=15% before stain application. MC >15% is HARD STOP.

compatibility_rules.title: Penetrating stain over film-forming coating is PROHIBITED
compatibility_rules.rule: Penetrating stain (semi-transparent, semi-solid) cannot penetrate through film-forming coating (solid stain, paint). If existing is film-forming and target is penetrating, MUST strip existing coating fully before applying penetrating stain.
compatibility_rules.enforcement: Assessment module TSK_DKRP_ASSESS_COATING_ID identifies existing coating type. If penetrating over film: full strip mandatory.

compatibility_rules.title: Spray-only prohibited for penetrating stains
compatibility_rules.rule: Back-brushing MANDATORY when spraying penetrating stains.
compatibility_rules.enforcement: spray_backbrush auto-includes back-brush step. spray_only prohibited.

compatibility_rules.title: Solid stain delamination risk — compounded on RP
compatibility_rules.rule: Film-forming solid stain on horizontal surfaces traps moisture. COMPOUNDED on RP — each coat adds film thickness. If existing is solid stain, assess total film build. >10 mil DFT = full strip mandatory regardless of visible condition.
compatibility_rules.enforcement: Assessment + customer risk disclosure. Recommend penetrating stain alternatives.

compatibility_rules.title: Chemical restoration requires separate mobilization
compatibility_rules.rule: Chemical strip + brighten + rinse requires 24-48 hr dry time. Separate mobilization day.

compatibility_rules.title: Unknown existing coating treated as incompatible
compatibility_rules.rule: When existing coating type cannot be identified, treat as incompatible — bonding primer required for solid stain, full strip required for penetrating stain.
compatibility_rules.enforcement: TSK_DKRP_ASSESS_COATING_ID determines type. Unknown triggers most conservative path.

compatibility_rules.title: Composite decking excluded
compatibility_rules.rule: Composite decking is excluded. Manufacturer warranties voided if coated.

compatibility_rules.title: Rot is HARD STOP for affected component
compatibility_rules.rule: Rot identified during rot probe = hard stop for that component. Refer to carpenter. Remaining components proceed.

compatibility_rules.title: Cedar/redwood tannin management on stripped surfaces
compatibility_rules.rule: Cedar and redwood stripped to bare wood require brightener treatment for tannin management. Oil-based stains resist bleed better.
compatibility_rules.enforcement: SYS_EXT_DECK_BRIGHTENER activated for failing/peeling. Cedar/redwood substrate_type modifier 1.10-1.15x.

round_configurations.name: Two Coats Wet-on-Absorbing — Semi-Transparent / Semi-Solid RP
round_configurations.notes: Penetrating stain 2-coat. Apply first coat, let absorb 30-60 min, apply second coat. No interstage inspection. All RP gets 2 coats (stripped wood absorbs more).

round_configurations.name: Two Coats with Full Dry — Solid Stain RP
round_configurations.notes: Film-forming. Full dry between coats (4-24 hr). Interstage inspection for holidays, runs, sags.

variants.notes: BASELINE RP. Sound existing penetrating stain on PT pine floor. Light scuff sand + 2 coats semi-transparent. Minimal prep, maximum production. Most common maintenance restain.
Common residential refinish. Worn floor with traffic wear-through. Brush for full deck. Moderate prep at wear areas.
Chemical restore activated. Strip + brighten + rinse (separate day) + 2 coats. Significant prep overhead.
HIGHEST PREP VARIANT. Peeling solid stain must be fully stripped. Solid over solid adds delamination risk. Full protection suite. Recommend customer disclosure.
Premium cedar deck refinish. Sound existing, upgrade to semi-solid for color build. Brush for railings. Cedar substrate modifier 1.10x.
Solid stain over existing paint. Bonding primer required (SYS_EXT_DKRP_BONDING_PRIMER). Paint is incompatible base for stain — primer bridges adhesion gap.
Failing redwood deck. Chemical restore + tannin management (brightener). Redwood modifier 1.15x. Brush for full deck control.
Pad applicator for floor-only restain. Efficient for large flat deck areas. Worn PT pine with moderate prep.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Siding at ledger board. Protection is THIS spec's responsibility.

risk_flags.title: Solid stain delamination compounded on RP
risk_flags.description: Each coat of solid stain adds film thickness on horizontal surfaces. RP over existing solid stain creates multi-layer film trapping moisture from above and below. Highest delamination risk of any RP configuration.
risk_flags.mitigation: Assess total existing film build. >10 mil DFT = strip. Recommend penetrating stain alternatives. Customer risk disclosure mandatory.

risk_flags.title: Unknown existing coating compatibility
risk_flags.description: Decks with unknown coating type risk adhesion failure. Oil over latex, latex over oil, stain over paint — all potential failure modes.
risk_flags.mitigation: Solvent wipe test in assessment module. If unknown after testing, treat as incompatible — bonding primer or full strip.

risk_flags.title: Multi-layer existing coatings resist standard strippers
risk_flags.description: Decks with 3+ previous coatings may require multiple strip cycles or mechanical removal not modeled in standard rates.
risk_flags.mitigation: Assessment includes existing film build estimate. Flag for estimator review if >3 previous coats suspected.

risk_flags.title: Rot at hidden locations
risk_flags.description: Rot may exist at post bases, stair stringers, or ledger board — hidden by existing coating. Stripping reveals hidden damage.
risk_flags.mitigation: Rot probe in assessment module. Hard stop for affected component. Carpenter referral.

site_condition_rules.notes: No height modifier for deck restaining — ground-level work. Same as NC.

cross_spec_boundaries.boundary: Window and door masking at deck entry
cross_spec_boundaries.notes: Door and window protection owned by respective specs.
Siding PROTECTION at ledger board is THIS spec. Siding painting is separate.
Board replacement, joist repair — not painting scope. Assessment IDENTIFIES, does not repair.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup -> Assess (condition, coating ID, adhesion, moisture, rot) -> Prep Floor (sand, wash, mildew) -> Prep Railing (sand, wash) -> Chemical Restore (failing/peeling, separate day) -> Apply Floor -> Apply Railing/Spindles -> Apply Stairs -> Cleanup
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Siding -> Landscape/hardscape -> Furniture staging -> Fixture masking -> Work -> Teardown -> Furniture return -> Tool cleanup
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Coat 1 (all components) -> Absorption/dry time -> Coat 2 -> Final inspect -> Touch-up
sequencing_notes.component_order: Floor FIRST -> Railings SECOND -> Stairs LAST (exit path)
sequencing_notes.chemical_restoration_sequence: Strip apply -> Dwell -> Scrub -> Rinse -> Brighten apply -> Dwell -> Rinse -> 24-48 hr dry -> RETURN VISIT
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO spray-only on penetrating stains. NO staining at MC >15%. NO penetrating stain over film-forming coating without strip. Composite decking EXCLUDED.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for exterior deck repaint/restain. First RP spec for deck surfaces — sibling to SF_DECK_EXT (NC). Key features: assessment-first workflow (condition, coating ID, adhesion, moisture, rot), coating_type as primary dimension (semi_transparent/semi_solid/solid_stain — clear_sealer excluded from RP), existing_coating_condition as RP-specific secondary dimension (sound/worn/failing/peeling), existing_coating_type for compatibility (penetrating_stain/solid_stain/paint/unknown), coating compatibility matrix enforced (penetrating over film = FAIL), bonding primer for incompatible existing coatings, chemical restoration for failing/peeling (separate mobilization day), 4 paintable items across 3 UOM types (reused from NC), 43 tasks across 9 modules, 6 material systems (3 stain + 1 bonding primer + 2 prep chemical), 3 factor modifiers (coating_type inherited, existing_condition RP-specific, substrate_type inherited), 2 round configurations, 5 protection zones (reused from NC), 8 variants, 13 PaintScope inputs. Max modifier stack 2.88x under 4.0x cap. Application rates identical to NC. Prep is the RP cost driver.
